notes.title: Release date is here!
notes.notes:
[h1]Release date is here![/h1]
Hello, dice people :D I hope that you are doing well.
It's been a while, but I have been continuously working on the game, and I am delighted to share with you the release date of Pip My Dice as well as some more news.
[h2]Release Date[/h2]
PC/Linux/SteamDeck:  [b]2025/07/25[/b] - I hope you're hyped; I am! 
Mobile/Console: Still unsure - More info to come later.
[h2]Detailed Features[/h2]
Since I have finished implementing most parts of the game, I can already share with you that in version 1.0.0 there will be:
- 130 Relics
- About 40 Face modifiers and 15 paints (Not counting value changers/ value modifiers)
- 25 Consumables
- 24 Bosses
- 15 Cups
- 4 Difficulty settings
- 40 Steam achievements + 1 (all achievements)
- Stats & Run History
- Daily runs (In a very simple format, which might evolve in later updates) with dedicated leaderboards
[h2]Rebranding[/h2]
Never forget, folks, there is nothing more permanent than a temporary fix. "FokazLabs" is one of them, and it is about time that it changes. I'm changing it to "Diving Swan Games" - I'm the swan!
This is not really important but don't be surprised if you see this on the Steam page now; it's still just me :)
[h2]Tell a friend about the game![/h2]
If you're willing to help me the extra step, spreading the word about the game is the best thing you can do! 
That's it for now, thank you :)

[b]Take care and have fun[/b]

notes.title: Update 0.9.17 live
notes.notes:
[h2] Features[/h2][list]
[*]  Animations have been added between all the different views
[*]  New content has been added, 3 of them being references to games that inspired me, let's see if you can find them all :D 
[*]  Some content has been removed, and some content from the playtest has been revived!
[*]  I've done some balancing, please read the description of the relics you already know as they might have changed!
[*]  The tutorial has been improved
[/list][h2] Bug fixes[/h2][list]
[*]  Fixed that a Set Value modifier could be wasted on a dice face that already has that value
[*]  Fixed a (nasty) bug where, during exceptionnal conditions, would throw you back to the previous boss instead of your current round when reloading the run
[*]  Fixed a bug where sometimes a seethrough face would show the wrong value
[*]  The stat "Dice rolled" was incorrect, it has been fixed
[*]  Fixed that in some instances of using negative dice, negative money was being given
[*]  Fixed that the relic Golden Cutlery was accounting for dice faces not in the scoring combination
[*]  Fixed that the relic Ladder would sometime give a higher bonus than it should
[*]  Fixed that playing a run on the same seed but with different cups would give different bosses
[*]  Fixed some visual artifacts
[*]  Fixed that the setting "Show text instead of pips" would not apply to face modifiers
[/list][h2] Balancing[/h2][list]
[*]  The yellow die has been reworked to work like so: It will give you between $1 and $Value with a 50% chance rate, Max $20 
[*]  Changed the rarity of some relics
[*]  Balanced some relics 
[/list][h2] QoL[/h2][list]
[*]  Added a button to the slots to bring all the dice from your hand there
[*]  The shop will not show duplicate relics anymore
[*]  Tried to improve the wording on some relics
[/list][h2] Misc[/h2][list]
[*]  Added more variety to the Value Modifiers, from +1,+2,+3,+5,+10 to +1,+2,...,+9,+10
[*]  Added a warning to prevent players from losing a saved run when clicking on the tutorial button
[*]  New players have now the option to skip the tutorial, but are invited to try it with a pop[*] up the first time they start a run
[*]  Added stats for consumable used and obtained at the end of a run
[*]  Added some SFX

notes.title: Demo update and leaderboards reset: 2025-01-25
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello and best wishes for 2025![/h1]
The demo for Pip My Dice will get an update to rotate some of the content and fix some bugs. The official date is the 25th of January. I will post the details of the update in another event
[h2]Leaderboards reset[/h2]
Because of the content being updated, the yellow die bug being patched, etc., the leaderboards will be reset in all categories! You will also not be able to finish a run that you started on the previous version for obvious reasons. So make sure to finish your run before the update!
I will put the previous build on a beta branch for those of you who still want to play with the current version of the yellow die, with leaderboards disabled.
[h2]Release Date[/h2]
Unfortunately, I have pushed back the full game release to Q2 2025 :c I want to provide you with the best experience, and within the given timeframe, it's not possible. 
I hope you understand, being a solo dev with a full-time job to pay the bills is not a walk in the park!
[h2]Endless mode[/h2]
I know that some of you are dying for endless mode; that's why I'll host a closed beta, probably in early March, for you to test it out and give feedback on, as well as other features. Access to the closed beta will be given on Discord; make sure to join if you haven't already: https://discord.com/invite/YXKxNNafzY

That's it for now. A big thank you to all of you for being part of the community and playing my silly dice game :D 

[b]Take care and have fun[/b]

notes.title: QoL Update 0.8.3 Live!
notes.notes:
[h2]Features
[/h2][list]
[*] It is now possible to sell consumables; the price varies according to their rarity
[*] Added two buttons to sort the dice by color or value
[/list]
[h2]Bug fixes
[/h2][list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the game data could get corrupted if the device unexpectedly shut down during the save
[*] Fixed the typewrite sound effect getting stuck when clicking a reward too fast

[*] Changed the outline color of relics based on rarity

notes.title: Version 0.7.4-demo is ready for Next Fest!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

I am sorry that I haven't posted here about the latest changes in the Demo, here is the whole changelog since version 0.6.3-playtest. I usually publish the changelog in discord, but I will make sure to do it here as well in the future.

Take care

[h2] Major changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Difficulty settings:[/b] In order to make the game accessible for more, the demo features 3 difficulties. The hard difficulty is the difficulty from the previous playtest; there will be more difficulty settings in the full game
[*] [b]Leaderboards are here![/b] And they are numerous. Are you the richest, fastest, or highest-scoring player? On which difficulty setting? Is the run seeded? There is a leaderboard for all of these! Feel free to suggest more
[*] [b]Rotation of the content[/b]: In order for the demo to not be overwhelming with content for new players, and since there is no progression system to unlock different elements of the game yet, some of the relics and face modifiers (and a cup) from the playtest have been removed for the demo. Don't worry if you've lost your favorite relic, it's coming back in the full game
[*] [b]More focus on the consumables[/b]. Consumables were there already in the playtest but hardly noticeable. They play a bigger role in the demo as they are connected to more relics and some new modifiers.
[/list]
[h2] Bug fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the cumulative score was not correctly calculated
[*] Fixed a bug where the game will get stuck when using some of the new relics
[*] Fixed the tutorial window going out of bounds 
[*] Fixed SeeThrough face not working properly when the face itself doesn't have a value
[*] Fixed that the Dice Customization and the Info buttons were not working in the first round of the tutorial
[*] Fixed various obscure bugs in the tutorial
[*] Fixed that consumables could disappear under certain circumstances
[*] Fixed some display issues at high resolutions, specifically for round rewards going out of screen
[*] Fixed a rare bug that would make dice vanish when going to dice customization .-. The visual glitch might remain but the dice won't vanish anymore
[*] Added a warning to restart the game when changing the resolution settings for a better experience
[*] Fixed various small bugs
[/list]
[h2] QoL[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a shortcut for the settings: Esc
[*] Long pressing R (2 sec) will restart the run with the same cup and difficulty. If the run is seeded, it will use the same seed. If the run is unseeded, a new random seed will be generated.
[*] The drag and drop has been improved. Remember trying to put a die somewhere and it would just go back to the bottom? That's not happening anymore :)
[*] Added VSync setting, enabled by default
[*] Increased the visibility of the selected face in the dice customization menu
[*]The end screen now shows a **Replay** button, which has the same behavior as **holding R for 2 seconds **
[*] It is now possible to hover on the selected die in Dice Customization to see the modifiers' effects
[*] The reward screen after a round now allows to go to the Dice Customization
[*] The reward screen after a round now shows the current amount of money held by the player
[*] The reward screen after a round now shows the score reached / target
[/list]
[h2] Content[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added 7 new face modifiers, removed 4 from the playtest for this build
[*] Added 18 new relics, removed 18 from the playtest for this build
[*] Added 1 new boss
[*] Added a new cup
[*] Added new modifiers to temper even more with the value of the dice
[/list]
[h2] Misc[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed some language/typos
[*] Added animation for the consumables
[*] Made it more obvious that an item is not affordable in the shop
[*] Made the rarity more obvious in the shop
[*] Random dice now only show their values/modifiers when they're obtained
[*] Added a (very) easy-to-get achievement to experiment with this feature
[*] To unlock a cup, it is now necessary to win a run with the previous cup
[*] Add a disclaimer that the run data will be lost if a new run is started
[*] Add a disclaimer for Steam Deck users that the experience is not yet optimized for Steam Deck
[/list]
[h2] Others[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added French Localization
[/list]
